editorial_choices.three_way_baskets: 带走封箱、留下、路上现用的实际分组，不再解释为衣书闲物各省三分比例。具体筐/包/人员和放置仅为本候选场面施工，不升级为来源定数。
editorial_choices.ginger_location: 一个姜包自整理起与药分别包裹，随身包由婆子抱上船，开船复点后安在手边，晕船时从该处取出；不再把姜忽置第五口箱。
editorial_choices.luggage_and_people: No asserted historically exact five-chest manifest, numeric follower census, named new servant or changing-shift sailor. Explicit household-to-carrier-to-boat handling and reopened lashings/labels are enacted; a precise count is not locked as source fact.
editorial_choices.letter_timeline: No predeparture half-written letter. Only channel inquiry before departure; initial writing after departure and immediate inventory; unfinished undated letter clipped into travel register; following dawn after overnight care date added; after breakfast the explicit 已能吃粥 update added. Letter remains unsealed in register awaiting an actual carrier.
editorial_choices.letter_delivery_limit: NO_HANDOFF_OR_ARRIVAL_CLAIM. Boatman has not found an actual known return carrier and promises only to report when one appears. A future handoff must be separately written and read before any later chapter claims receipt. This chapter does not retrospectively cure or endorse the unread chapter-83 delivery claim noted by the editor.
editorial_choices.forbidden_drift_avoided: No husband/family name, political task, destination, sea route, precise wedding date, prophecy, no-return verdict, second crying farewell, invented lost poem or send-off verse. No arithmetic/logistics lecture substitutes for the enacted work.
